lessons.title: Reading: The Silk Road's Legacy
lessons.context: A short passage about the historical Silk Road and its lasting influence.

paragraphs.uz: Ipak yo'li qadimda Sharq va G'arbni bog'lovchi asosiy savdo yo'li bo'lgan.
paragraphs.en: The Silk Road was the main trade route connecting East and West in ancient times.

paragraphs.uz: Bu yo'l orqali nafaqat mahsulotlar, balki g'oyalar ham tarqalgan.
paragraphs.en: Through this road, not only goods but also ideas spread.

paragraphs.uz: Samarqand va Buxoro bu yo'lning muhim markazlaridan bo'lgan.
paragraphs.en: Samarkand and Bukhara were important centers of this route.

paragraphs.uz: Savdogarlar bu shaharlarda turli xalqlar bilan muloqot qilishgan.
paragraphs.en: Merchants communicated with various peoples in these cities.

paragraphs.uz: Natijada, madaniyatlar bir-biri bilan boyib borgan.
paragraphs.en: As a result, cultures enriched one another.

paragraphs.uz: Bugungi kunda bu meros turizm rivojiga xizmat qilmoqda.
paragraphs.en: Today, this legacy serves the development of tourism.

paragraphs.uz: Ko'plab sayohatchilar bu tarixiy shaharlarni ko'rishga intilishadi.
paragraphs.en: Many travelers aspire to see these historical cities.

questions.question: Ipak yo'li nima uchun muhim bo'lgan?
Qaysi shaharlar Ipak yo'lining markazi bo'lgan?
Bugungi kunda bu meros nimaga xizmat qilmoqda?
